name: sec_filing_search
description: Search and retrieve SEC EDGAR filings for a publicly traded US company. Use this when you need official regulatory disclosures: 10-K (annual), 10-Q (quarterly), 8-K (material events), or DEF 14A (proxy statements). This is the Tier-1 (highest reliability) source.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, MSFT

name: web_search
description: Perform a general web search for current news, analysis, or commentary about a company or financial topic. Use for information not available in structured sources.

name: earnings_transcript
description: Retrieve the earnings call transcript for a specific company, quarter, and year, including the analyst Q&A section.

name: financial_data_api
description: Retrieve structured financial statement data: income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, and key ratios. This is a Tier-2 reliability source.

name: news_sentiment
description: Analyze the sentiment of recent news articles about a company or topic using NLP, returning per-article summaries plus an overall sentiment score.

name: vector_db_search
description: Search the agent's long-term memory (vector database) for previously researched information about a company or topic. Always check this before making redundant external calls.

name: vector_db_store
description: Store new research findings in the agent's long-term memory for future retrieval.

name: company_profile
description: Retrieve basic company information: sector, industry, market cap, key executives, and a short description.

name: peer_comparison
description: Identify industry peers for a company and retrieve comparative financial metrics across the peer set.

name: calculation_engine
description: Perform financial calculations: growth rates, ratios, a simplified DCF, or basic statistics, on data already gathered.

name: fact_checker
description: Cross-reference a specific numerical or factual claim against multiple sources already gathered (or newly retrieved) to verify accuracy and assign a confidence score.

name: report_generator
description: Format all researched, synthesized data into a structured investment research report in markdown, following the standard section template.
